description_ru: Кейт и Джек сравнивают Испанию, Грецию и Турцию по цене, погоде и дороге и бронируют поездку. Примеры сравнительных степеней.
text:
Kate: Jack, I have good news. My boss said yes. I can take two weeks of holiday in August.
Jack: That is fantastic! Where do you want to go?
Kate: I want to go somewhere warm. Last year we went to the mountains, and it rained every day.
Jack: I remember. My boots were wet for a week. So the beach this time?
Kate: Yes. But which beach? There are so many choices.
Jack: Let us make a list. I looked at three places yesterday. Spain, Greece and Turkey.
Kate: Tell me about them. Which one is the cheapest?
Jack: Turkey is cheaper than the other two. A hotel with breakfast costs about sixty euros a night.
Kate: And Greece?
Jack: Greece is more expensive, about eighty euros. But the islands are more beautiful, and the food is better.
Kate: I am not sure about that. I loved the food in Spain last time. The seafood was incredible.
Jack: Spain is the most expensive of the three. And it is also the most crowded in August.
Kate: Crowded beaches are not relaxing. I would prefer a quiet place.
Jack: Then I recommend a small Greek island. There are fewer tourists, and the water is clearer.
Kate: How do we get there? Is there a direct flight?
Jack: There is a flight to Athens, and then you take a ferry. The whole trip takes about nine hours.
Kate: That is longer than I wanted. Turkey is closer, right?
Jack: Yes, the flight is only four hours. And it is a bit warmer there than in Greece.
Kate: Hmm. I do not like very hot weather. Thirty-five degrees makes me tired.
Jack: In Greece, it is about thirty in August, and there is a nice wind from the sea.
Kate: That sounds better. What can we do there, apart from lying on the beach?
Jack: We can rent a small boat and visit the other islands. There are also old temples and mountain villages.
Kate: I love old temples. But I do not want to walk too much in the heat.
Jack: We can go early in the morning, before the sun gets strong. And we can rest in the afternoon.
Kate: That is a good plan. What about swimming? I am a slow swimmer, and I am afraid of big waves.
Jack: The bay on this island is very calm. Children swim there all day.
Kate: Excellent. How did you find all this information?
Jack: My colleague Olga went there two years ago. She said it was the best holiday of her life.
Kate: Did she give you the name of the hotel?
Jack: Yes. It is a small family hotel called Blue Door. The owner cooks breakfast for the guests.
Kate: That sounds lovely. How much is it for two weeks?
Jack: About eleven hundred euros for the room, and the flights are three hundred each.
Kate: So the whole holiday costs about seventeen hundred euros. That is a lot of money.
Jack: It is, but we saved nine hundred already. And I am going to get a bonus in June.
Kate: Really? You did not tell me that.
Jack: I wanted it to be a surprise. My manager told me yesterday.
Kate: That is wonderful news. Then we can afford a good holiday.
Jack: Exactly. And we can still buy some gifts for our families.
Kate: Let me look at the website. Oh, the price of the flights is going up next week.
Jack: Then we should book today. Do you have your credit card?
Kate: It is in my bag. But wait, let me check the dates first. Our flight is on the second of August?
Jack: Yes, and we come back on the sixteenth. That is exactly fourteen days.
Kate: Are you sure that your passport is still valid?
Jack: Good question. I will look at it tonight. If it is not, I will renew it tomorrow.
Kate: Please do. Last time, you forgot, and we nearly missed the plane.
Jack: That was five years ago. I am much more careful now.
Kate: Right. And what about insurance? My sister says it is necessary.
Jack: She is right. The booking website offers insurance for twenty euros. It covers lost bags and doctors.
Kate: Let us take it. A broken leg on holiday would be a disaster.
Jack: Please do not say that. You are going to bring bad luck.
Kate: I am only being sensible. Now, which seats do you prefer, a window or an aisle?
Jack: A window, of course. I want to see the islands from the sky.
Kate: Fine, but I choose the next flight. I always get the worst seat.
Jack: Deal. OK, everything is ready. Press the button.
Kate: Done! We are going to Greece in August. I cannot believe it.
Jack: I cannot wait. I am going to pack my sun cream tomorrow.
Kate: It is only March. You are impossible.
Jack: I know. But you can never prepare too early for the sea.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Дифтонг: широкое «а» плавно переходит в короткое «и»; второй элемент слабее первого.
Язык между зубами, как для θ, но с голосом; звук мягкий и звонкий, не «з» и не «д».
Долгий звук «и»: губы растянуты, язык высоко впереди; держите его дольше, чем русское «и».

questions.question: Why does Kate want a warm place?
questions.answer: Last year it rained every day in the mountains.

questions.question: Where do they decide to go?
What surprise news does Jack have?
questions.answer: He will get a bonus in June.
